exposure: early caffeine administration (within 24 hours after birth)
late caffeine administration (within 48 hours after birth or later)
cohort: The study included 2381 very preterm infants born at <32 weeks gestation who initially received invasive mechanical ventilation, with specific analysis on those born at more than 28 weeks of gestation.
finding: Early administration of caffeine (within 24 hours after birth) in very preterm infants who initially receive invasive mechanical ventilation significantly shortens the duration of invasive mechanical ventilation and reduces the incidence of moderate-to-severe bronchopulmonary dysplasia, particularly for those born at more than 28 weeks gestation, without apparent adverse outcomes.
gest_age: <32 weeks gestation (with specific findings for those >28 weeks gestation)
